retroFuturePresets.philosophy: This data-set provides the technical parameters for 'Retro-Future' spaces—acoustic environments that combine the warmth of 1970s hardware with the clean air of modern digital R&B.

archetypes.name: The Chrome Plate (Modern Soul)
archetypes.vibe: Warm mid-range 'Soul' with a shimmering digital high-end. Perfect for Neo-Soul vocals.

archetypes.name: The Neon Warehouse (Psy-Trap)
archetypes.vibe: Huge, swelling, hazy textures. The sound of a physical space being 'stretched' by a computer.

archetypes.name: The Analog Starship (Moody R&B)
archetypes.vibe: Dark, intimate, and seemingly infinite. The sound of being 'Alone in Space'. Ideal for deep background ad-libs.

engineeringLogic.action: Set Convolver to 'LL' (Low Latency) mode but set the Master Wrapper 'Oversampling' to 2x during render. This preserves the 'Hi-Freq' air of the custom IRs.
Always use the internal Convolver EQ to cut below 400Hz. This prevents the 'Ghost Space' from making your 808 sound flabby.
